bio: A restaurant with a historical name (the “Artabrians” were a Celtic tribe who settled in the area) located close to Riazor beach. From the attractively appointed dining room, the kitchen to the rear is partially visible to guests, who can select from a classic à la carte or the option of a varied menu. Specialities well worth trying include the crunchy dish of scallops with a crab cream, smoked salmon rolls with prawn tartare, creamy Carabineros prawns with rice, plus lamprey in season. It is often full thanks to the support of its loyal clientele....
